parameters.name: text
parameters.constraints: Mandarin or US English, including mixed text; nonblank, at most 2000 UTF-8 bytes. Spell out English decimals and currency; no Markdown or emoji.

actions.doc: Internal text mapping: Assistant submits text to speechSynthesis, then resolves playAudio on the same Channel.

parameters.name: text
parameters.constraints: Nonblank; at most 2000 UTF-8 bytes. Original formatting is preserved.

actions.doc: Append text to the conversation caption. Preserves accepted text, including surrounding whitespace.

parameters.name: emotion
parameters.description: The emotion expressed by the two animated blue eyes; no emoji or text glyphs.
parameters.constraints: Exactly one of: clear, smile, happy, laugh, thinking, surprised, sad, love, angry, scared, playful. clear smoothly returns the eyes to neutral.

actions.doc: Smoothly change the procedural eye expression. clear returns to neutral. Never render an emoji as the expression. Does not modify captions or speech. The Assistant clears its previous expression on new user speech.
Begin the current conversation turn once: atomically clear the previous reply and expression. Preserve recognition text.

parameters.name: audioID
parameters.constraints: Single consumption, scoped to the originating input and session.

actions.doc: Internal playback of accepted synthesis audio; waits at most three seconds for each missing PCM chunk.

tools.doc: Read the fixed local runtime configuration description. This is not a live health or model-readiness probe.
